nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the Flink runtime image with Python data-processing libraries plus Kafka and S3 connectors. It installs the job submission utilities used to run Flink workloads in the project.
nodes.languageNotes: The image extends Flink 1.19 and adds connector JARs directly to Flink's user-library and plugin directories.

nodes.name: flink
nodes.summary: Flink service image stage that provides the configured runtime for stream-processing jobs.
